description: Solo team from Singapore. I am a third-year Mechanical Engineering student at Nanyang Technological University, specialising in robotics and mechatronics. I am building HazeLedger, one consistent fire record for Sumatra, Borneo and the Malay Peninsula that joins NASA's MODIS and VIIRS hotspot archives. Skills: engineering analysis, programming and data visualisation. This is a solo entry, so I am not recruiting members.
